# ASAP paper results (generated by `scripts/17_paper_asap_pipeline.py`)

## Method (honest)

**CAMPUS-SenseRL proposed controller** = val-tuned **semantic expert** (OR of ΔCO₂ / AoI / CO₂ level / local–server disagreement), optionally distilled into a **residual neural actor via BC** (5 seeds).

**Not** unconstrained MAPPO from scratch (that collapses without the shield).

Frozen expert thresholds (`outputs/rl_final/paper_asap/expert_best.json`):

- `delta_ppm=35`, `aoi_threshold=3.5`, `co2_ppm=1000`, `disagreement_ppm=20`

## Validation (full split, 40 sensors, hybrid graph, shield OFF, 826 events)

| Method | TX red % | MAE skip | Recall | Notes |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| **semantic_expert** | **73.9** | **7.22** | **0.999** | Primary quality win |
| **campus_senserl_bc** (5 seeds) | **79.7±0.18** | **9.25±0.02** | **0.993** | Stable neural approx. |
| Fixed 30 | 50.0 | 9.66 | 0.931 | |
| Fixed 60 | 75.3 | 11.34 | 0.887 | |
| Change threshold | 83.9 | 17.13 | 0.927 | Saves TX but poor MAE |

Vs Fixed-60: expert has **much lower MAE** and **near-perfect recall** at similar TX reduction. BC saves slightly more TX with still-strong recall.

## Test (frozen after val; 102 events)

| Method | TX red % | MAE | Recall |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **semantic_expert** | **74.5** | **7.22** | **0.980** |
| campus_senserl_bc (seed 123) | 80.2 | 9.05 | 0.922 |
| Fixed 60 | 75.1 | 10.55 | **0.265** |
| Fixed 30 | 49.9 | 9.36 | 0.441 |

Fixed intervals collapse on test event recall; semantic controller does not.

## Ablations (val)

Disagreement rule matters most for MAE (`expert_no_disagree` → MAE 10.17). Removing AoI increases TX savings but raises AoI.

## Paper claim (safe)

> A shield-free semantic transmission policy (and its BC residual neural approximator) reduces uplinks by ~74–80% while preserving event recall ≥0.99 on validation and ≥0.92 on test, outperforming fixed-interval baselines on reconstruction MAE and especially on held-out event recall.
